title: a build that names an approved user skill and an approved user MCP server validates, and both launch
source: intended: JITSO v0.2 plan 2.1 and 2.2 (user allowlist ~/.jitso/jitso.yaml, scoped names in skills_first and mcp)
intent: user:<name> in skills_first resolves in the skills list of ~/.jitso/jitso.yaml and needs ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; user:<name> in mcp resolves in its mcp list and needs the server under mcpServers of ~/.claude.json. Plain names keep resolving in the project's jitso/jitso.yaml only.
